D029802.definition: A plant genus of the family EUPHORBIACEAE. The common name of dragon's blood is also used for DRACAENA and Daemonorops (ARECACEAE). Croton tiglium is the source of CROTON OIL.

D029803.name: Phyllanthus
D029803.definition: A plant genus of the family EUPHORBIACEAE. Bahupatra (MEDICINE, AYURVEDIC) is prepared from this.

D029821.name: Enterovirus A, Human
D029821.definition: A species of ENTEROVIRUS infecting humans and containing 10 serotypes, mostly coxsackieviruses.

D029822.name: Enterovirus B, Human
D029822.definition: A species of ENTEROVIRUS infecting humans and containing 36 serotypes. It is comprised of all the echoviruses and a few coxsackieviruses, including all of those previously named coxsackievirus B.

D029842.name: Phyllanthus emblica
D029842.definition: A plant species of the family EUPHORBIACEAE.

D029843.name: Suregada
D029843.definition: A plant genus of the family EUPHORBIACEAE that contains gelonin, a ribosome-inactivating protein.

D029845.name: Amphibian Proteins
D029845.definition: Proteins obtained from species in the class of AMPHIBIANS.

D029846.name: Senna Plant
D029846.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. SENNA EXTRACT is obtained from members of this genus. Members contain ANTHRAQUINONES and have been an ingredient in laxatives (CATHARTICS). Many species of the CASSIA genus have been reclassified into this genus. This bush should not be confused with the Cassia tree (CINNAMOMUM).

D029861.name: Tamarindus
D029861.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE known for its sour fruit.

D029862.name: Prosopis
D029862.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is a source of prosopis gum.

D029863.name: Cicer
D029863.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE known for the edible beans.

D029864.name: Crotalaria
D029864.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains crotalarin.

D029865.name: Cytisus
D029865.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is sometimes called broom because of the shape of the plant. Members produce SPARTEINE.

D029866.name: Derris
D029866.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. The root is a source of rotenoids (ROTENONE) and flavonoids. Some species of Pongamia have been reclassified to this genus and some to MILLETTIA. Some species of Deguelia have been reclassified to this genus.

D029867.name: Xenopus Proteins
D029867.definition: Proteins obtained from various species of Xenopus. Included here are proteins from the African clawed frog (XENOPUS LAEVIS). Many of these proteins have been the subject of scientific investigations in the area of MORPHOGENESIS and development.

D029881.name: Galega
D029881.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains galegine (GUANIDINES). Most of the other species have been reclassified to TEPHROSIA; a few to ASTRAGALUS PLANT; and INDIGOFERA.

D029882.name: Glycyrrhiza uralensis
D029882.definition: A plant species of the family FABACEAE.

D029883.name: Indigofera
D029883.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. The common name of indigo also refers to Baptisia or Amorpha genera (FABACEAE).

D029884.name: Lespedeza
D029884.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE.

D029885.name: Lotus
D029885.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. This genus was formerly known as Tetragonolobus. The common name of lotus is also used for NYMPHAEA and NELUMBO.

D029901.name: Maackia
D029901.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. It contains a hemagglutinin.

D029902.name: Medicago
D029902.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. It is distinct from Sweet Clover (MELILOTUS), from Bush Clover (LESPEDEZA), and from Red Clover (TRIFOLIUM).

D029903.name: Melilotus
D029903.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE.

D029904.name: Myroxylon
D029904.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is a source of aromatic resinous balsams (Balsam of Tolu and Balsam of Peru) used in perfumery and as a constituent in cough syrups and lozenge.

D029905.name: Pachyrhizus
D029905.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. Some Pachyrhizus have been reclassified to PUERARIA. Do not confuse with yam (IPOMOEA; or DIOSCOREA) or African yam bean (SPHENOSTYLIS).

D029906.name: Physostigma
D029906.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is a source of PHYSOSTIGMINE.

D029907.name: Psoralea
D029907.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is a source of psoralen (FICUSIN).

D029908.name: Pueraria
D029908.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE a common weed of the southeast US. There has been folk use for alcoholism and liver protection. It contains puerarin, kakkalide, daidzein (isoflavonoids), and kudzusaponins (oleanene-type triterpene glycosides).

D029909.name: Sophora
D029909.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE.

D029910.name: Trigonella
D029910.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE.

D029911.name: Caesalpinia
D029911.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. The common name of "Bird-Of-Paradise" is also used for other plants such as Heliconia (HELICONIACEAE) and Strelitzia (STRELITZIACEAE) and some birds. The common name of "Cat's-Claw" is more often used with UNCARIA. The common name of "Pernambuco" also refers to a state in Brazil. Furanoditerpenoid lactones and caesalpin are produced by members of this genus.

D029912.name: Abrus
D029912.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. Members contain ABRIN.

D029921.name: Trifolium
D029921.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE.

D029941.name: Fish Proteins
D029941.definition: Proteins obtained from species of fish (FISHES).

D029961.name: Zebrafish Proteins
D029961.definition: Proteins obtained from the ZEBRAFISH. Many of the proteins in this species have been the subject of studies involving basic embryological development (EMBRYOLOGY).

D029962.name: Fagaceae
D029962.definition: A plant family of the order Fagales subclass Hamamelidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D029963.name: Quercus
D029963.definition: A plant genus of the family FAGACEAE that is a source of TANNINS. Do not confuse with Holly (ILEX).

D029964.name: Fagus
D029964.definition: A plant genus of the family FAGACEAE.

D029965.name: Gentianaceae
D029965.definition: A plant family of the order Gentianales, subclass Asteridae, class Magnoliopsida.

D029966.name: Centaurium
D029966.definition: A plant genus of the family GENTIANACEAE. Triterpene lactones and other compounds have been isolated from species of this genus. The common name of century plant has also been used for the AGAVE genus.

D029967.name: Swertia
D029967.definition: A plant genus of the family GENTIANACEAE. It is a source of swertiapuniside and IRIDOID GLYCOSIDES.

D029969.name: Angelica
D029969.definition: A plant genus of the family Apiaceae.

D029970.name: Angelica archangelica
D029970.definition: A plant species of the family Apiaceae that contains COUMARINS.

D029971.name: Angelica sinensis
D029971.definition: A plant species of the family APIACEAE that is the source of dong quai.

D029972.name: Bupleurum
D029972.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE that is the source of bupleurum root and of bupleurotoxin and is an ingredient of sho-saiko-to.

D029974.name: Carum
D029974.definition: A plant genus of the family Apiaceae. The seeds are used as flavoring.

D029981.name: Cicuta
D029981.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE. It is a source of cicutoxin.

D029982.name: Conium
D029982.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE that is a source of coniine.

D030001.name: Foeniculum
D030001.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE used in SPICES.

D030002.name: Heracleum
D030002.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE. Members contain COUMARINS.

D030003.name: Levisticum
D030003.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE.

D030004.name: Ligusticum
D030004.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE.

D030005.name: Sanicula
D030005.definition: A plant genus of the family Apiaceae. Commonly called snakeroot but that name is used for many other plants such as ASARUM; ARISTOLOCHIA; and Polygala.

D030006.name: Amsonia
D030006.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE. Species of this genus contain YOHIMBINE.

D030007.name: Nerium
D030007.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE. It is a very poisonous plant that contains cardioactive agents.

D030008.name: Catharanthus
D030008.definition: A plant genus of the family Apocynaceae. It is the source of VINCA ALKALOIDS, used in leukemia chemotherapy.

D030009.name: Aspidosperma
D030009.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE. It contains ellipticine.

D030010.name: Apocynum
D030010.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE. On rare occasions it is called Milkweed, but should not be confused with true Milkweed (ASCLEPIAS).

D030011.name: Ochrosia
D030011.definition: A plant genus of the family Apocynaceae. Species of this genus contain 9-methoxyellipticine (ELLIPTICINES) which is the basis of one of the classes of ANTINEOPLASTIC AGENTS.

D030012.name: Gentiana
D030012.definition: A plant genus of the family Gentianaceae whose members contain SECOIRIDOIDS and have been used in TRADITIONAL MEDICINE for suppressing INFLAMMATION.

D030013.name: Strophanthus
D030013.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE that contains OUABAIN cardiac glycosides.

D030014.name: Tabernaemontana
D030014.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE that contains bisindole alkaloids and IBOGAINE.

D030015.name: Enterovirus C, Human
D030015.definition: A species of ENTEROVIRUS infecting humans and containing 11 serotypes, all coxsackieviruses.

D030016.name: Enterovirus D, Human
D030016.definition: A species of ENTEROVIRUS infecting humans and consisting of 2 serotypes: Human enterovirus 68 and Human enterovirus 70.

D030017.name: Ilex
D030017.definition: A plant genus of the family AQUIFOLIACEAE. The common name of 'holly' usually refers to this genus but may sometimes refer to similar looking plants of the MAHONIA or QUERCUS genus.

D030018.name: Ilex guayusa
D030018.definition: A plant species of the family AQUIFOLIACEAE known for ritual use by Amazonian Jivaro Indians.

D030019.name: Ilex paraguariensis
D030019.definition: A plant species of the family AQUIFOLIACEAE. An infusion of the leaves is commonly drunk in South America for stimulating effect in much the same manner as coffee is in other cultures.

D030020.name: Ilex vomitoria
D030020.definition: A plant species of the family AQUIFOLIACEAE. It has been used to induce vomiting in purification rites.

D030021.name: Pinellia
D030021.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE that contains pinellian (an acidic polysaccharide). The plant is an ingredient of some traditional Asian medicinal mixtures including sho-saiko-to, saiko-keishi-to, and banxia houpu decoction.

D030022.name: Aristolochia
D030022.definition: A plant genus of the family ARISTOLOCHIACEAE. Species of this genus have been used in traditional medicine but they contain aristolochic acid which is associated with nephropathy. These are sometimes called 'snakeroot' but that name is also used with a number of other plants such as POLYGALA; SANICULA; ASARUM; ARISTOLOCHIA; AGERATINA; and others.

D030023.name: Asarum
D030023.definition: A plant genus of the family ARISTOLOCHIACEAE which was used medicinally by North American Indians. The common name of 'snakeroot' is also used for many other plants, including SANICULA; or ARISTOLOCHIA; or Polygala.

D030024.name: Curcuma
D030024.definition: A plant genus of the family ZINGIBERACEAE that contains CURCUMIN and curcuminoids.

D030041.name: Hepatitis A virus
D030041.definition: A species in the genus HEPATOVIRUS containing one serotype and two strains: HUMAN HEPATITIS A VIRUS and Simian hepatitis A virus causing hepatitis in humans (HEPATITIS A) and primates, respectively.

D030061.name: Parechovirus
D030061.definition: A genus in the family PICORNAVIRIDAE infecting humans and rodents. The type species is Human parechovirus.

D030081.name: Palyam Virus
D030081.definition: A species of ORBIVIRUS infecting cattle and sheep. It is transmitted by culicine mosquitoes and gnats (CULICOIDES).

D030101.name: Orthoreovirus, Avian
D030101.definition: A species of ORTHOREOVIRUS infecting birds, with outcomes ranging from inapparent to lethal depending on the virus strain and age of the host bird. This species does not infect mammals.

D030102.name: Orthoreovirus, Mammalian
D030102.definition: A species of ORTHOREOVIRUS infecting mammals (other than baboons). There are four serotypes. In humans they are generally benign but may sometimes cause upper respiratory tract illness or enteritis in infants and children. MAMMALIAN ORTHOREOVIRUS 3 is a very pathogenic virus in laboratory rodents.

D030121.name: Betaretrovirus
D030121.definition: A genus of the family RETROVIRIDAE consisting of viruses with either type B or type D morphology. This includes a few exogenous, vertically transmitted and endogenous viruses of mice (type B) and some primate and sheep viruses (type D). MAMMARY TUMOR VIRUS, MOUSE is the type species.

D030141.name: Feedback, Psychological
D030141.definition: A mechanism of information stimulus and response that may control subsequent behavior, cognition, perception, or performance. (From APA Thesaurus of Psychological Index Terms, 8th ed.)

D030161.name: Avian Proteins
D030161.definition: Proteins obtained from species of BIRDS.

D030162.name: Reptilian Proteins
D030162.definition: Proteins obtained from species of REPTILES.

D030181.name: Vitamin D Response Element
D030181.definition: A DNA sequence that is found in the promoter region of vitamin D regulated genes. Vitamin D receptor (RECEPTOR, CALCITRIOL) binds to and regulates the activity of genes containing this element.

D030201.name: Activin Receptors, Type I
D030201.definition: One of the two types of ACTIVIN RECEPTORS or activin receptor-like kinases (ALK'S). There are several type I activin receptors. The major active ones are ALK-2 (ActR-IA) and ALK-4 (ActR-IB).

D030221.name: Cola
D030221.definition: A plant genus of the family STERCULIACEAE. This is the source of the kola nut which contains CAFFEINE and is used in popular beverages.

D030241.name: Diarrhea Virus 1, Bovine Viral
D030241.definition: A species of PESTIVIRUS causing systemic infections (BOVINE VIRUS DIARRHEA-MUCOSAL DISEASE) in cattle and some other cloven-hoofed animals. There are several strains and two biotypes: cytopathic (rare) and non-cytopathic. Infections range from clinically inapparent to severe, but do not correlate with biotypes.

D030242.name: Diarrhea Virus 2, Bovine Viral
D030242.definition: A species of PESTIVIRUS causing systemic infections including BOVINE VIRUS DIARRHEA-MUCOSAL DISEASE and BOVINE HEMORRHAGIC SYNDROME in cattle and some other cloven-hoofed animals. There are several strains and two biotypes: cytopathic (rare) and non-cytopathic. The severity of disease appears to be strain dependent. Cytopathogenic effects do not correlate with virulence as non-cytopathic BVDV-2 is associated only with Hemorrhagic Disease, Bovine.

D030243.name: Hemorrhagic Syndrome, Bovine
D030243.definition: Clinically severe acute disease of cattle caused by noncytopathic forms of Bovine viral diarrhea virus 2 (DIARRHEA VIRUS 2, BOVINE VIRAL). Outbreaks are characterized by high morbidity and high mortality.

D030261.name: Primate T-lymphotropic virus 1
D030261.definition: A species in the family DELTARETROVIRUS comprising strains of different host species but arising from the same geographic origin. They include HUMAN T-LYMPHOTROPIC VIRUS 1 and SIMIAN T-LYMPHOTROPIC VIRUS 1.

D030262.name: Soybean Proteins
D030262.definition: Proteins which are present in or isolated from SOYBEANS.

D030263.name: Primate T-lymphotropic virus 2
D030263.definition: A species in the family DELTARETROVIRUS, comprising strains from different host species but arising from the same geographic origin. They include HUMAN T-LYMPHOTROPIC VIRUS 2; SIMIAN T-LYMPHOTROPIC VIRUS 2; and Simian T-lymphotropic virus - PP.

D030281.name: Simian T-lymphotropic virus 2
D030281.definition: A strain of PRIMATE T-LYMPHOTROPIC VIRUS 2 isolated from Congolese bonobos (PAN PANISCUS).

D030282.name: Primate T-lymphotropic virus 3
D030282.definition: A species of DELTARETROVIRUS that includes the strains SIMIAN T-LYMPHOTROPIC VIRUS 3 and HUMAN T-LYMPHOTROPIC VIRUS 3.

D030283.name: Epsilonretrovirus
D030283.definition: A genus in the family RETROVIRIDAE infecting fish. Species include Walleye dermal sarcoma virus, Walleye epidermal hyperplasia virus 1, and Walleye epidermal hyperplasia virus 2.

D030301.name: Activin Receptors, Type II
D030301.definition: One of the two types of ACTIVIN RECEPTORS. They are membrane protein kinases belonging to the family of PROTEIN-SERINE-THREONINE KINASES. The major type II activin receptors are ActR-IIA and ActR-IIB.

D030321.name: Denys-Drash Syndrome
D030321.definition: A disorder of sex development characterized by UROGENITAL ABNORMALITIES; GONADAL DYSGENESIS; and WILMS TUMOR. It is caused by a mutation in the Wilms tumor suppressor gene (GENES, WILMS TUMOR) on chromosome 11.

D030341.name: Nidovirales Infections
D030341.definition: Infections with viruses of the order NIDOVIRALES. The concept includes ARTERIVIRUS INFECTIONS and CORONAVIRIDAE INFECTIONS.

D030342.name: Genetic Diseases, Inborn
D030342.definition: Diseases that are caused by genetic mutations present during embryo or fetal development, although they may be observed later in life. The mutations may be inherited from a parent's genome or they may be acquired in utero.

D030361.name: Papillomavirus Infections
D030361.definition: Neoplasms of the skin and mucous membranes caused by papillomaviruses. They are usually benign but some have a high risk for malignant progression.

D030381.name: Nodaviridae
D030381.definition: A family of RNA viruses infecting insects and fish. There are two genera: Alphanodavirus and Betanodavirus.

D030401.name: Cytochrome-c Oxidase Deficiency
D030401.definition: A disease that results from a congenital defect in ELECTRON TRANSPORT COMPLEX IV. Defects in ELECTRON TRANSPORT COMPLEX IV can be caused by mutations in the SURF1, SCO2, COX10, or SCO1 genes. ELECTRON TRANSPORT COMPLEX IV deficiency caused by mutation in SURF1 manifests itself as LEIGH DISEASE; that caused by mutation in SCO2 as fatal infantile cardioencephalomyopathy; that caused by mutation in COX10 as tubulopathy and leukodystrophy; and that caused by mutation in SCO1 as early-onset hepatic failure and neurologic disorder. (from Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man, http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Omim, MIM#220110, May 17, 2001)

D030421.name: Peroxynitrous Acid
D030421.definition: A potent oxidant synthesized by the cell during its normal metabolism. Peroxynitrite is formed from the reaction of two free radicals, NITRIC OXIDE and the superoxide anion (SUPEROXIDES).

D030441.name: Saussurea
D030441.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE, order Asterales, subclass Asteridae. It is a source of costus root oil and should not be confused with the genus COSTUS.

D030481.name: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase (Lipoamide)
D030481.definition: The E1 component of the multienzyme PYRUVATE DEHYDROGENASE COMPLEX. It is composed of 2 alpha subunits (pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 alpha subunit) and 2 beta subunits (pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 beta subunit).

D030501.name: Epididymal Secretory Proteins
D030501.definition: Proteins secreted by the epididymal epithelium. These proteins are both tissue- and species-specific. They are important molecular agents in the process of sperm maturation.

D030521.name: Zingiberaceae
D030521.definition: A plant family of the order Zingiberales, subclass Zingiberidae, class Liliopsida. It includes plants which have both flavoring and medicinal properties such as GINGER; turmeric (CURCUMA), and cardamom (ELETTARIA).

D030541.name: Databases, Genetic
D030541.definition: Databases devoted to knowledge about specific genes and gene products.

D030561.name: Databases, Nucleic Acid
D030561.definition: Databases containing information about NUCLEIC ACIDS such as BASE SEQUENCE; SNPS; NUCLEIC ACID CONFORMATION; and other properties. Information about the DNA fragments kept in a GENE LIBRARY or GENOMIC LIBRARY is often maintained in DNA databases.

D030562.name: Databases, Protein
D030562.definition: Databases containing information about PROTEINS such as AMINO ACID SEQUENCE; PROTEIN CONFORMATION; and other properties.

D030601.name: Cistaceae
D030601.definition: A plant family of the order Violales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida. The common name of rock rose is used with several plants of this family.

D030661.name: Genetic Privacy
D030661.definition: The protection of genetic information about an individual, family, or population group, from unauthorized disclosure.

D030681.name: Ficus
D030681.definition: A plant genus of the family MORACEAE. It is the source of the familiar fig fruit and the latex from this tree contains FICAIN.

D030701.name: Nyssaceae
D030701.definition: A plant family of the order Cornales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida. Some botanical classifications do not recognize this family and place the members in CORNACEAE.

D030702.name: Nymphaeaceae
D030702.definition: The sour gum plant family of the order Nymphaeales, subclass Magnoliidae, class Magnoliopsida. All have horizontal or hanging branches and broad alternate leaves, and they are dioecious (male and female flowers on different plants).

D030721.name: Nymphaea
D030721.definition: A plant genus of the family NYMPHAEACEAE. The common name of lotus is also used for LOTUS and NELUMBO.

D030741.name: Carbonic Anhydrase IV
D030741.definition: A membrane-bound carbonic anhydrase found in lung capillaries and kidney.

D030762.name: Estrous Cycle
D030762.definition: The period of cyclic physiological and behavior changes in non-primate female mammals that exhibit ESTRUS. The estrous cycle generally consists of 4 or 5 distinct periods corresponding to the endocrine status (PROESTRUS; ESTRUS; METESTRUS; DIESTRUS; and ANESTRUS).

D030781.name: Organisms, Genetically Modified
D030781.definition: Organisms whose GENOME has been changed by a GENETIC ENGINEERING technique.

D030801.name: Animals, Genetically Modified
D030801.definition: ANIMALS whose GENOME has been altered by GENETIC ENGINEERING, or their offspring.

D030821.name: Plants, Genetically Modified
D030821.definition: PLANTS, or their progeny, whose GENOME has been altered by GENETIC ENGINEERING.

D030841.name: Food, Genetically Modified
D030841.definition: Food derived from genetically modified organisms (ORGANISMS, GENETICALLY MODIFIED).

D030861.name: Capitalism
D030861.definition: A political and economic system characterized by individual rights, by private or corporate ownership of capital goods, and by prices, production, and the distribution of goods that are determined mainly by competition in a free market. (From Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, 10th ed)

D030881.name: Disclosure
D030881.definition: Revealing of information, by oral or written communication.

D030921.name: Erythroxylaceae
D030921.definition: A plant family of the order Linales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida best known for the coca plant.

D030981.name: Acro-Osteolysis
D030981.definition: A condition with congenital and acquired forms causing recurrent ulcers in the fingers and toes. The congenital form exhibits autosomal dominant inheritance; the acquired form is found in workers who handle VINYL CHLORIDE. When acro-osteolysis is accompanied by generalized OSTEOPOROSIS and skull deformations, it is called HAJDU-CHENEY SYNDROME.

D031001.name: Aceraceae
D031001.definition: A plant family of the order Sapindales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida. Leaves are opposite and usually toothed or lobed. The fruit, a samara (a winged nutlet), splits into two (rarely three) winged, one-seeded parts. This family is widely distributed in the Northern Hemisphere.

D031002.name: Acer
D031002.definition: A plant genus of the family ACERACEAE, best known for trees with palmately lobed leaves.

D031003.name: Adoxaceae
D031003.definition: A plant family of the order Dipsacales, subclass Asteridae, class Magnoliopsida. Members of this family are sometimes classified in CAPRIFOLIACEAE.

D031021.name: Anacardium
D031021.definition: A plant genus of the family ANACARDIACEAE. This is the source of the familiar cashew nuts, which are heat treated to remove the irritant toxin. Cashew nut shell liquid (frequently abbreviated as CNSL) is a major source of alkenyl phenolic compounds, especially ANACARDIC ACIDS, cardol, and cardanol.

D031022.name: Mangifera
D031022.definition: A plant genus of the family ANACARDIACEAE best known for the edible fruit.

D031023.name: Semecarpus
D031023.definition: A plant genus of the family ANACARDIACEAE that is the source of anacarcin forte. The nut milk extract is cytotoxic.

D031041.name: Annona
D031041.definition: A plant genus of the family ANNONACEAE. It has edible fruit and seeds which contain acetogenins and benzoquinazoline and other alkaloids.

D031042.name: Asimina
D031042.definition: A plant genus of the family ANNONACEAE. It has edible fruit and seeds which contain asitrocin, asitrilobins, and other tetrahydrofuran acetogenins.

D031043.name: Guatteria
D031043.definition: A plant genus of the family ANNONACEAE. Members contain asarone, isoguattouregidine (an isoquinoline alkaloid), norlaureline, puterine, noraporphine alkaloids.

D031044.name: Polyalthia
D031044.definition: A plant genus of the family ANNONACEAE. Members contain 8-oxopolyalthiaine.

D031045.name: Rollinia
D031045.definition: A plant genus of the family ANNONACEAE. Members contain aporphines, acetogenins and rollinone.

D031046.name: Uvaria
D031046.definition: A plant genus of the family ANNONACEAE. Members contain uvarigrin, uvarigrandin, chamuvaritin and other acetogenins and benzylisoquinoline alkaloids.

D031048.name: Cnidium
D031048.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE. Members contain osthol.

D031049.name: Eryngium
D031049.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE. Members contain SAPONINS.

D031050.name: Oenanthe
D031050.definition: A plant genus of the family APIACEAE that is sometimes called Hemlock Water Dropwort but should not be confused with HEMLOCK. It contains enanthotoxin.

D031051.name: Alstonia
D031051.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE. Members contain echitovenidine, echitamine, venenatine (an indole alkaloid), and anti-inflammatory triterpenoids

D031052.name: Thevetia
D031052.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE. Members contain thevetin.

D031053.name: Vinca
D031053.definition: A plant genus of the family APOCYNACEAE. Vinca rosea has been changed to CATHARANTHUS roseus.

D031055.name: Alocasia
D031055.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. Members contain beta-glucosidases and trypsin inhibitors.

D031056.name: Amorphophallus
D031056.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. Members contain konjac glucomannan (MANNANS) and SEROTONIN.

D031057.name: Arisaema
D031057.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. It has a stemless, tuberous root.

D031058.name: Arum
D031058.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. The name derived from ar (fire in Arabic) due to the irritating sap. Flower is a spathe.

D031059.name: Calla Plant
D031059.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. Calla Lily (Callalily) also refers to the ZANTEDESCHIA. There is no relationship with CALLA ANTIGEN.

D031060.name: Colocasia
D031060.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. Members contain acrid calcium oxalate and LECTINS. Polynesians prepare the root into poi. Common names of Taro and Coco Yam (Cocoyam) may be confused with other ARACEAE; XANTHOSOMA; or with common yam (DIOSCOREA).

D031061.name: Cyrtosperma
D031061.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE that may be confused with other ARACEAE having similar common names.

D031062.name: Philodendron
D031062.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. As a houseplant it sometimes poisons children and animals.

D031063.name: Xanthosoma
D031063.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. The common names of 'Coco Yam' (Cocoyam) or 'Elephant's Ear' may be confused with COLOCASIA and other ARACEAE or with common yam (DIOSCOREA). It contains LECTINS.

D031064.name: Zantedeschia
D031064.definition: A plant genus of the family ARACEAE. The common name of Calla Lily or Callalily also refers to the Calla genus (CALLA PLANT).

D031081.name: Calamus
D031081.definition: A plant genus of the family ARECACEAE that should not be confused with ACORUS CALAMUS.

D031101.name: Marsdenia
D031101.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. Members contain pregnane glycosides (marsdekoiside & marstomentosides, maryal) and hainaneosides (SAPONINS).

D031102.name: Hemidesmus
D031102.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. It is a source of PREGNANES. It is sometimes an adulterant of commercial sarsaparilla.

D031103.name: Gymnema
D031103.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE.

D031104.name: Gymnema sylvestre
D031104.definition: A plant species of the genus GYMNEMA that contains gymnemic acid (triterpene SAPONINS) which affects blood sugar level, and gurmarin protein. The common name of Gurmar should not be confused with Guar (CYAMOPSIS).

D031105.name: Cynanchum
D031105.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. Members contain steroidal glycosides and cytotoxic phenanthroindolizidine N-oxide alkaloids.

D031106.name: Cryptolepis
D031106.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. Members contain the alkaloids quindoline, CSA-3, cryptolepine, and neocryptolepine.

D031107.name: Calotropis
D031107.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. The downy akund floss fiber from the seeds is used like kapok.

D031108.name: Asclepias
D031108.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. This is the true milkweed; APOCYNUM & EUPHORBIA hirta are rarely called milkweed. Asclepias asthmatica has been changed to TYLOPHORA.

D031109.name: Periploca
D031109.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. It is a source of periplocosides (pregnane steroid glycosides).

D031110.name: Tylophora
D031110.definition: A plant genus of the family ASCLEPIADACEAE. Members contain phenanthro-indolizidine alkaloids.

D031111.name: Balanophoraceae
D031111.definition: A plant family of the order Santalales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida. They are root parasites lacking CHLOROPHYLL.

D031112.name: Begoniaceae
D031112.definition: A plant family of the order Violales (by some in Begoniales), subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida. Members are found throughout tropical and warm temperate habitats. Most are perennial herbs with monoecious flowers (both sexes on the same plant). Fruits are usually capsules containing many tiny seeds.

D031121.name: Mannheimia
D031121.definition: Genus of bacteria in the family PASTEURELLACEAE, comprising multiple species that do not ferment trehalose. Species include MANNHEIMIA HAEMOLYTICA; M. glucosida, M. granulomatis, M. ruminalis, and M. varigena.

D031161.name: Pseudoalteromonas
D031161.definition: A genus of GRAM-NEGATIVE AEROBIC BACTERIA of marine origin. Many species were formerly classified under ALTEROMONAS.

D031162.name: Achillea
D031162.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE that has long been used in folk medicine for treating wounds.

D031163.name: Ageratum
D031163.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE that contains PYRROLIZIDINE ALKALOIDS. Yellow vein disease of Ageratum is caused by a viral DNA complex of a begomovirus (GEMINIVIRIDAE).

D031164.name: Ambrosia
D031164.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. The POLLEN is one cause of HAYFEVER.

D031165.name: Ammi
D031165.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE that is the primary plant source of KHELLIN.

D031166.name: Anthemis
D031166.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE that is similar to MATRICARIA but this has tiny chaffy bract scales between each pair of florets. Members contain sesquiterpene lactones. Other plants with similar common names include FERULA; FOENICULUM; MATRICARIA; CHAMAEMELUM and TRIPLEUROSPERMUM.

D031167.name: Chamaemelum
D031167.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE that is used in folk medicine as CHAMOMILE. Other plants with similar common names include MATRICARIA; TRIPLEUROSPERMUM and ANTHEMIS.

D031168.name: Matricaria
D031168.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. M. chamomilla appears similar to Anthemis but this flower disk is conical and hollow and lacks chaffy bract scales and the odor is weaker. The common name of 'manzanilla' is confused with other meanings of the word. 'Matricaria chamomilla sensu' is classified by some as Tripleurospermum perforata. Other plants with similar common names include CHAMAEMELUM; TRIPLEUROSPERMUM and ANTHEMIS.

D031169.name: Tripleurospermum
D031169.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. It is easily confused with related plants with similar common names of Chamomile and Mayweed (MATRICARIA; CHAMAEMELUM; and ANTHEMIS).

D031170.name: Arctium
D031170.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Arctiin (LIGNANS) is in the seed.

D031171.name: Artemisia absinthium
D031171.definition: A plant species of the genus ARTEMISIA, family ASTERACEAE that has been used in ABSINTHE. The oil contains neurotoxic 1-thujone and d-isothujone.

D031172.name: Artemisia annua
D031172.definition: A plant species of the genus ARTEMISIA, family ASTERACEAE. It is the source of the antimalarial artemisinin (ANTIMALARIALS).

D031173.name: Aster Plant
D031173.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. This plant should not be confused with microtubule asters (MICROTUBULES) nor with aster yellows phytoplasma (mycoplasma-like organisms).

D031174.name: Atractylodes
D031174.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain hinesol and atractylon. Atractylodes rhizome is Byaku-jutsu. A. lancea rhizome is So-jutsu.

D031175.name: Baccharis
D031175.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Other plants called broom include CYTISUS; SPARTIUM; and BROMUS.

D031176.name: Bidens
D031176.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain bidensyneosides (polyacetylene glucosides).

D031177.name: Carduus
D031177.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain arctiin and onopordopicrin.

D031178.name: Carthamus
D031178.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE.

D031179.name: Centaurea
D031179.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain 5-methyl-8-hydroxycoumarin. The common name of centaury is more often used for CENTAURIUM

D031180.name: Cirsium
D031180.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain pectolinarin (a flavonoid glycoside).

D031181.name: Cnicus
D031181.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain cnicin.

D031182.name: Echinops Plant
D031182.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain a pseudoguaiane sesquiterpene. San-fang-feng is the root of E. grijisii used in DRUGS, CHINESE HERBAL.

D031183.name: Onopordum
D031183.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain eudesmane and elemane SESQUITERPENES.

D031184.name: Sonchus
D031184.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Sesquiterpene lactone glucosides (SESQUITERPENES) have been found in it.

D031185.name: Scolymus
D031185.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE with a name that is similar to CYNARA SCOLYMUS. Members contain taraxasteryl acetate.

D031186.name: Scorzonera
D031186.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. INULIN and SESQUITERPENES have been found in it.

D031187.name: Carthamus tinctorius
D031187.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Oil from the seed (SAFFLOWER OIL) is an important food oil of commerce.

D031188.name: Tragopogon
D031188.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. The root and shoots have been used for food.

D031202.name: Chrysanthemum
D031202.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. The common names of daisy or marguerite are easily confused with other plants. Some species in this genus have been reclassified to TANACETUM.

D031203.name: Tanacetum
D031203.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Some species of the CHRYSANTHEMUM and the old Pyrethrum genera have been reclassified to this genus. The common name of tansy usually refers to this but also forms part of the common name of other plants such as Tansy Ragwort (SENECIO) and Tansyaster (HAPLOPAPPUS).

D031204.name: Caloric Restriction
D031204.definition: Reduction in caloric intake without reduction in adequate nutrition. In experimental animals, caloric restriction has been shown to extend lifespan and enhance other physiological variables.

D031205.name: Taraxacum
D031205.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain chicoric and chlorogenic acids and germacrane- and eudesmane-type SESQUITERPENES.

D031206.name: Haplopappus
D031206.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Many of the member species have been reclassified to other genera such as Machaeranthera, Isocoma, Ericameria, etc. Ingestion of the plant has been associated with MILK SICKNESS.

D031207.name: Tussilago
D031207.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Flower buds contain farfaratin (SESQUITERPENES) and bisabolene epoxide.

D031208.name: Verbesina
D031208.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain galegine (GUANIDINES).

D031209.name: Wedelia
D031209.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. Members contain wedelolactone and wedeloside.

D031210.name: Xanthium
D031210.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. The name "prickly burweed" is sometimes used but causes confusion with AMSINCKIA.

D031211.name: Corylus
D031211.definition: A plant genus of the family BETULACEAE known for the edible nuts.

D031212.name: Bixaceae
D031212.definition: A plant family of the order Violales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida. Bixa contains bixin. Cochlospermum contains arjunolic acid and gum kondagogu (POLYSACCHARIDES).

D031213.name: Cordia
D031213.definition: A plant genus of the family BORAGINACEAE. Members contain TRITERPENES and naphthoxirene.

D031214.name: Arabis
D031214.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE. Member species are ornamentals grown for their numerous small white, yellow, pink, or purplish flowers.

D031215.name: Armoracia
D031215.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE known for the root used in hot SPICES. It is also the source of HORSERADISH PEROXIDASE which is widely used in laboratories.

D031216.name: Barbarea
D031216.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE. Members contain glucobrassicin.

D031217.name: Cardamine
D031217.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE that is low-growing in damp meadows of the Northern Hemisphere and has pinnately divided leaves and small white to rose flowers.

D031218.name: Crambe Plant
D031218.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE. Members contain crambin.

D031219.name: Isatis
D031219.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE that is an ingredient of the preparation PC-SPES that is used to treat PROSTATIC HYPERPLASIA.

D031220.name: Lepidium sativum
D031220.definition: A plant species of the genus LEPIDIUM, family BRASSICACEAE that is a fast-growing, often weedy native of western Asia. It is widely grown, especially in its curl-leaved form, and used as a garnish

D031221.name: Knee Dislocation
D031221.definition: Slippage of the FEMUR off the TIBIA.

D031222.name: Patellar Dislocation
D031222.definition: Displacement of the PATELLA from the femoral groove.

D031223.name: Nasturtium
D031223.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE. Nasturtium is also used as a common name for TROPAEOLUM. The common name of watercress is also used for RORIPPA & TROPAEOLUM. This is the most popular of the edible cresses, is a hardy creeping perennial plant, native to Europe but extensively naturalized elsewhere in moist places.

D031224.name: Raphanus
D031224.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE known for its peppery red root.

D031225.name: Rorippa
D031225.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE that includes several marshy plants. The common name of watercress is also used for NASTURTIUM & TROPAEOLUM.

D031226.name: Sinapis
D031226.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE. The common name of white mustard sometimes refers to other plants (MUSTARD PLANT).

D031227.name: Thlaspi
D031227.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE that is grown in rock gardens. T. arvense is grown for its large, round ornamental seed pods. The common name of pennycress usually refers to this genus but may also refer to the genus Microthlaspi.

D031228.name: Wasabia
D031228.definition: A plant genus of the family BRASSICACEAE used for its hot peppery root.

D031229.name: Bromeliaceae
D031229.definition: A plant family of the order Bromeliales, subclass Zingiberidae, class Liliopsida (monocotyledons).

D031230.name: Ananas
D031230.definition: A plant genus of the family BROMELIACEAE known for the edible fruit that is the source of BROMELAINS.

D031231.name: Bromelia
D031231.definition: A plant genus of the family BROMELIACEAE. Members contain karatasin and balansain (ENDOPEPTIDASES) and BROMELAINS.

D031232.name: Tillandsia
D031232.definition: A plant genus of the family BROMELIACEAE. Members contain 3-methoxy-5-hydroxyflavonols.

D031233.name: Bursera
D031233.definition: A plant genus of the family BURSERACEAE. Members contain a PODOPHYLLOTOXIN.

D031234.name: Buxaceae
D031234.definition: A plant family of the order Euphorbiales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida. Leaves are alternate, simple, and leathery. Fruits are one- or two-seeded capsules or drupes (stony-pitted fleshy fruits).

D031235.name: Buxus
D031235.definition: A plant genus of the family BUXACEAE. Members contain steroidal alkaloids.

D031236.name: Pachysandra
D031236.definition: A plant genus of the family BUXACEAE that should not be confused with common spurge (EUPHORBIA).

D031237.name: Calycanthaceae
D031237.definition: A plant family of the order Laurales, subclass Magnoliidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031238.name: Platycodon
D031238.definition: A plant genus of the family CAMPANULACEAE that contains platycodin and other triterpenoid SAPONINS. It is a constituent of kikyo-to (MEDICINE, KAMPO).

D031239.name: Lonicera
D031239.definition: A plant genus of the family CAPRIFOLIACEAE. Members contain iridoid glucosides.

D031240.name: Symphoricarpos
D031240.definition: A plant genus of the family CAPRIFOLIACEAE. The common name of "snowberry" is also used for GAULTHERIA.

D031241.name: Caricaceae
D031241.definition: A plant family of the order Violales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031242.name: Agrostemma
D031242.definition: A plant genus of the family CARYOPHYLLACEAE that contains ALLANTOIN and a ribosome-inactivating protein.

D031243.name: Arenaria Plant
D031243.definition: A plant genus of the family CARYOPHYLLACEAE. The common name of sandwort is used with other plants. Do not confuse with Arenaria bird or with other genera which use arenaria as the species name such as Mya arenaria (softshell clam) or Meloidogyne arenaria, or Ammophila arenaria (marram grass).

D031244.name: Lychnis
D031244.definition: A plant genus of the family CARYOPHYLLACEAE. The common name "Campion" is also used with SILENE.

D031245.name: Vaccaria
D031245.definition: A plant genus of the family CARYOPHYLLACEAE. The common name "Soapwort" is also used with SAPONARIA.

D031246.name: Cecropiaceae
D031246.definition: A plant family of the order Urticales, subclass Hamamelidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031247.name: Celastrus
D031247.definition: A plant genus of the family CELASTRACEAE that contains insecticidal sesquiterpenoids and celastrus oil.

D031248.name: Salsola
D031248.definition: A plant genus of the family CHENOPODIACEAE. The extract may be called lochein. Tumbleweed may occasionally refer to AMARANTHUS.

D031249.name: Erdheim-Chester Disease
D031249.definition: A rare form of non-Langerhans-cell histiocytosis (HISTIOCYTOSIS, NON-LANGERHANS-CELL) with onset in middle age. The systemic disease is characterized by infiltration of lipid-laden macrophages, multinucleated giant cells, an inflammatory infiltrate of lymphocytes and histiocytes in the bone marrow, and a generalized sclerosis of the long bones.

D031250.name: Clethraceae
D031250.definition: A plant family of the order Ericales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031251.name: Clusia
D031251.definition: A plant genus of the family CLUSIACEAE. Members contain benzophenones.

D031252.name: Mammea
D031252.definition: A plant genus of the family CLUSIACEAE. Members contain xanthones and BENZOPHENONES. The common name of Mamey is also used with POUTERIA.

D031253.name: Calystegia
D031253.definition: A plant genus of the family CONVOLVULACEAE. Members contain calystegine and calystegins.

D031254.name: Convolvulus
D031254.definition: A plant genus of the family CONVOLVULACEAE. The common name of morning glory also refers to IPOMOEA. The common name of bindweed also refers to IPOMOEA; CALYSTEGIA; or POLYGONUM.

D031255.name: Carex Plant
D031255.definition: A plant genus of the family CYPERACEAE. The seed contains oligostilbenes (STILBENES).

D031256.name: Eleocharis
D031256.definition: A plant genus of the family CYPERACEAE.

D031257.name: Droseraceae
D031257.definition: A plant family of the order Nepenthales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida, notable for leaves with sticky gland-tipped hairs that entrap insects.

D031261.name: Poult Enteritis Mortality Syndrome
D031261.definition: An acute, transmissible, infectious disease associated with high MORTALITY and MORBIDITY in young turkeys (poults). It is characterized by DIARRHEA; ANOREXIA; growth depression, and immune dysfunction. The cause is unknown but astroviruses (AVASTROVIRUS) and coronaviruses (CORONAVIRUS, TURKEY) have been isolated from diseased poults and are thought to cause the enteritis and increased susceptibility to bacterial infections.

D031262.name: Ebenaceae
D031262.definition: A small plant family of the order Ebenales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida. Members contain NAPHTHOQUINONES.

D031263.name: Elaeagnaceae
D031263.definition: A plant family of the order Rhamnales, subclass Rosidae class Magnoliopsida. The plants have a characteristic silvery or rusty-colored sheen, caused by tiny distinctive scales. Flowers have a tubular structure of four sepals. Root nodules host the Frankia (ACTINOMYCETES) nitrogen-fixing symbionts.

D031281.name: Hippophae
D031281.definition: A plant genus of the family ELAEAGNACEAE. Linoleic (18:2n-6) and alpha-linolenic acids (18:3n-3) comprised about 70% of seed oil fatty acids. This is unrelated to 'artificial sea buckthorn oil'. This genus does not belong to the buckthorn family (RHAMNACEAE).

D031282.name: Gaultheria
D031282.definition: A plant genus of the family ERICACEAE. The common name of "wintergreen" is also used for PYROLA and "snowberry" is also used for SYMPHORICARPOS.

D031283.name: Eucommiaceae
D031283.definition: A plant family of the order Eucommiales, subclass Hamamelidae, class Magnoliopsida (some botanists have classified this in the order Hamamelidales or Urticales). Eucomia is an elmlike tree of central and eastern China. Leaves are alternate; deciduous flowers are solitary and unisexual and lack petals and sepals. The male flowers have 6 to 10 stamens and female flowers have one ovary of two carpels, one of which aborts during development so the fruit (a dry, winged structure) contains only one seed. The latex is a source of RUBBER. Tochu tea is an aqueous extract of Eucommia ulmoides leaves and a popular beverage in Japan. (Mutat Res 1997 Jan 15;388(1):7-20).

D031284.name: Aleurites
D031284.definition: A plant genus of the family EUPHORBIACEAE that is the source of tung oil and a phorbol diester (PHORBOL ESTERS).

D031285.name: Hippomane
D031285.definition: A plant genus of the family EUPHORBIACEAE. The trees contain hippomanin A and the latex is a skin irritant.

D031286.name: Jatropha
D031286.definition: A plant genus of the family EUPHORBIACEAE. Members contain jatrophone and other diterpenes.

D031287.name: Sapium
D031287.definition: A plant genus of the family EUPHORBIACEAE that contains bukittinggine and PHORBOL ESTERS.

D031288.name: Chamaecrista
D031288.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. Some species were reclassified from CASSIA and Senna.

D031289.name: Albizzia
D031289.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains julibroside (triterpenoid saponins).

D031290.name: Butea
D031290.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains butrin and isobutrin.

D031291.name: Castanospermum
D031291.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains castanospermines, swainsonine, and triterpenoid saponins.

D031292.name: Clitoria
D031292.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains ternatins (anthocyanins) and preternatins, antifungal proteins, stigmast-4-ene-3,6-dione, and clitoriacetal (ROTENONE).

D031293.name: Cyamopsis
D031293.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is the source of guar gum.

D031294.name: Dolichos
D031294.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains LECTINS. Many members have been reclassified into other genera of the FABACEAE family.

D031295.name: Griffonia
D031295.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. Members contain Griffonia simplicifolia agglutin-I and griffonin.

D031296.name: Laburnum
D031296.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE named after the drooping clusters of flowers.

D031297.name: Lupinus
D031297.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is a source of SPARTEINE, lupanine and other lupin alkaloids.

D031298.name: Mimosa
D031298.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains kukulkanin, a CHALCONE.

D031299.name: Mucuna
D031299.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is the source of mucuna gum.

D031300.name: Retinal Vasculitis
D031300.definition: Inflammation of the retinal vasculature with various causes including infectious disease; LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS, SYSTEMIC; MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS; BEHCET SYNDROME; and CHORIORETINITIS.

D031301.name: Robinia
D031301.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains linarin (acaciin) and LECTINS.

D031302.name: Spartium
D031302.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is a source of SPARTEINE. Do not confuse with Broom or Scotch Broom (CYTISUS) or Butcher's Broom (RUSCUS) or Desert Broom (BACCHARIS) or Brome (BROMUS).

D031303.name: Sphenostylis
D031303.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains LECTINS and raffinose oligosaccharides.

D031304.name: Tephrosia
D031304.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains tephrorin, tephrosone, and C-prenylflavonoids.

D031305.name: Tetrapleura
D031305.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE. Members contain molluscicidal triterpene glycosides (TRITERPENES).

D031306.name: Vicia
D031306.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that is widely used as ground cover and forage and known for the edible beans, VICIA FABA.

D031307.name: Vicia faba
D031307.definition: A plant species of the genus VICIA, family FABACEAE. The edible beans are well known but they cause FAVISM in some individuals with GLUCOSEPHOSPHATE DEHYDROGENASE DEFICIENCY. This plant contains vicine, convicine, Vicia lectins, unknown seed protein, AAP2 transport protein, and Vicia faba DNA-binding protein 1.

D031308.name: Flacourtiaceae
D031308.definition: The Indian plum plant family of the order Violales, subclass Dilleniidae class Magnoliopsida, that are tropical and subtropical trees and shrubs.

D031309.name: Ryania
D031309.definition: A plant genus of the family FLACOURTIACEAE that is the source of RYANODINE.

D031310.name: Fumariaceae
D031310.definition: The fumitory, or bleeding-heart plant family of the order Papaverales, subclass Magnoliidae, class Magnoliopsida. Flowers are bisexual, with two small sepals and four petals, one pistil and six stamens.

D031311.name: Corydalis
D031311.definition: A plant genus of the family FUMARIACEAE (classified by some in PAPAVERACEAE) that contains isoquinoline alkaloids.

D031312.name: Fumaria
D031312.definition: A plant genus of the family FUMARIACEAE that contains fumariline and other isoquinoline alkaloids.

D031313.name: Gentianella
D031313.definition: A plant genus of the family GENTIANACEAE that contains nitiol (a C25 sesterterpenoid) & nitidasin.

D031314.name: Geraniaceae
D031314.definition: A plant family of the order Geraniales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031315.name: Geranium
D031315.definition: A plant genus of the family GERANIACEAE. Geranium is also used as a common name for PELARGONIUM.

D031316.name: Pelargonium
D031316.definition: A plant genus of the family GERANIACEAE. The common name of geranium is also used for the GERANIUM genus.

D031317.name: Liquidambar
D031317.definition: A plant genus of the family HAMAMELIDACEAE. The sap is a source of storax, which should not be confused with the similar named STYRAX genus.

D031318.name: Hippocastanaceae
D031318.definition: A plant family of the order Sapindales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031319.name: Aesculus
D031319.definition: A plant genus of the family HIPPOCASTANACEAE (or SAPINDACEAE by some) that contains antimicrobial protein 1 and escin. A. hippocastanum is used in folk medicine for treating chronic venous insufficiency.

D031320.name: Hippocrateaceae
D031320.definition: A plant family of the order Celastrales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida. The Hippocratea genus contains friedelanes, triterpenoid quinone, and hippocrateine I.

D031321.name: Hydrocharitaceae
D031321.definition: A plant family of the order Hydrocharitales, subclass ALISMATIDAE, class Liliopsida (monocotyledons).

D031322.name: Eriodictyon
D031322.definition: A plant genus of the family HYDROPHYLLACEAE that has a characteristic strong smell.

D031323.name: Iris Plant
D031323.definition: A plant genus of the family IRIDACEAE that contains IRIP, a type-1 ribosome-inactivating protein, and iridals (TRITERPENES).

D031324.name: Juglans
D031324.definition: A plant genus of the family JUGLANDACEAE that provides the familiar walnut.

D031325.name: Carya
D031325.definition: A plant genus of the family JUGLANDACEAE that bears edible nuts.

D031326.name: Krameriaceae
D031326.definition: A plant family of the order Polygalales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031327.name: Agastache
D031327.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains tilianin, agastanol, and agastaquinone (a cytotoxic diterpenoid quinone).

D031328.name: Ajuga
D031328.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains cyasterone, ajugasterone, 20-hydroxyecdysone, 8-acetylharpagide (an iridoid glycoside).

D031329.name: Ballota
D031329.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains phenylpropanoids.

D031330.name: Coleus
D031330.definition: A plant genus of the family Lamiaceae. The species of Coleus should be distinguished from PLECTRANTHUS BARBATUS - which is also known as Coleus forskohlii.

D031331.name: Hyptis
D031331.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains 5-methoxydehydropodophyllotoxin (a PODOPHYLLOTOXIN) and other LIGNANS.

D031332.name: Leonurus
D031332.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains leonurine.

D031333.name: Lycopus
D031333.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains rosmarinic acid and isopimarane diterpenoids and has been used in folk medicine for HYPERTHYROIDISM.

D031334.name: Melissa
D031334.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE. The common names of beebalm or lemonbalm are also used for MONARDA.

D031335.name: Mentha pulegium
D031335.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains pulegone. Do not confuse with 'American false pennyroyal' (HEDEOMA).

D031336.name: Hedeoma
D031336.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that is closely related to the European pennyroyal (MENTHA PULEGIUM).

D031337.name: Mentha spicata
D031337.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE having characteristic flavor.

D031338.name: Monarda
D031338.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE. The common names of beebalm or lemonbalm are also used for MELISSA. The common name of bergamot is also used for Citrus bergamia (CITRUS).

D031341.name: Origanum
D031341.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that is the source of a familiar food seasoning.

D031342.name: Orthosiphon
D031342.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains pimarane-type diterpenes. Several species of Orthosiphon are also called Java tea.

D031343.name: Perilla
D031343.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that is a source of perilla alcohol and the oil is rich in alpha-linolenic acid (alpha-18:3).

D031344.name: Perilla frutescens
D031344.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that is an ingredient of Banxia Houpu (DRUGS, CHINESE HERBAL).

D031345.name: Phlomis
D031345.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains phlorigidosides, iridoid glucosides and megastigmane glycosides.

D031346.name: Plectranthus
D031346.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains eudesmane sesquiterpenes and antimicrobial abietane diterpenoids.

D031347.name: Prunella
D031347.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE. Members contain TRITERPENES. Heal all is another common name.

D031362.name: Satureja
D031362.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE used to flavor food.

D031363.name: Scutellaria
D031363.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE used in folk medicine as a nervine.

D031364.name: Scutellaria baicalensis
D031364.definition: A plant species of the genus SCUTELLARIA, family LAMIACEAE, that contains skullcapflavone and is used in CHINESE HERBAL DRUGS.

D031365.name: Sideritis
D031365.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that contains isoscutellarein-7-O-(allosyl(1-2)glucoside).

D031366.name: Stachys
D031366.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE that has a characteristic odor.

D031367.name: Teucrium
D031367.definition: A plant genus of the family LAMIACEAE. Members contain teuscordonin. There have been reports of hepatoxicity by this genus.

D031368.name: Zoster Sine Herpete
D031368.definition: HERPES ZOSTER but without eruption of vesicles. Patients exhibit the characteristic pain minus the skin rash, sometimes making diagnosis difficult.

D031369.name: Cryptocarya
D031369.definition: A plant genus of the family LAURACEAE. Members contain cryptofolione, caryachine, grandisin and other compounds. Some PEUMUS species have been reclassified as CRYPTOCARYA.

D031381.name: Lecythidaceae
D031381.definition: A plant family of the order Lecythidales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031382.name: Barringtonia
D031382.definition: A plant genus of the family Lecythidaceae. Members contain nasimalun A and B (neo-clerodane diterpenoids).

D031383.name: Bertholletia
D031383.definition: A plant genus of the family Lecythidaceae which is the source of edible Brazil nuts.

D031384.name: Polygonatum
D031384.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain benzoquinones, steroidal saponin, and ribosome-inactivating proteins.

D031401.name: Smilacina
D031401.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. The cluster of flowers at the end of the stalk distinguishes this plant from "true" Solomon's seal (POLYGONATUM), which has flowers that grow along the stem.

D031402.name: Alstroemeria
D031402.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain allergens, tuliposide A and tulipalin A.

D031403.name: Anemarrhena
D031403.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain anemarans (POLYSACCHARIDES), hinokiresinol, mangiferin (a xanthone), and timosaponin (a steroidal saponin).

D031404.name: Camassia
D031404.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains steroidal SAPONINS and should not be confused with Death Camas (ZIGADENUS).

D031405.name: Convallaria
D031405.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains CARDIAC GLYCOSIDES.

D031406.name: Cordyline
D031406.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains spirostanol & furostanol SAPONINS.

D031407.name: Crinum
D031407.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains ALKALOIDS.

D031408.name: Curculigo
D031408.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains curculin and cycloartane saponins.

D031409.name: Dracaena
D031409.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. The common name of "dragon's blood" is also used for CROTON and Daemonorops (ARECACEAE).

D031410.name: Fritillaria
D031410.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members of this genus produce imperialine, a steroidal alkaloid which acts at muscarinic receptors.

D031421.name: Hemerocallis
D031421.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain steroidal saponins.

D031422.name: Hosta
D031422.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain steroidal saponins.

D031423.name: Hyacinthus
D031423.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Do not confuse with water hyacinth (EICHHORNIA).

D031424.name: Liriope Plant
D031424.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain ruscogenin. Do not confuse with the Liriope jellyfish (CNIDARIA).

D031425.name: Plasmodesmata
D031425.definition: Membrane-like channels of cytoplasm connecting adjacent plant cells. Plasmodesmata connect through pores in the CELL WALL and associate with the CYTOSKELETON machinery. They are essential for intercellular transport and communication.

D031426.name: Lycoris
D031426.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain radiatine, vittatine, haemanthamine, lycorenine, dihydrolycorine, lycorine, lycoricidinol and lycoricidine.

D031427.name: Narcissus
D031427.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain ungiminorine and LECTINS.

D031441.name: Ophiopogon
D031441.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain steroidal glycosides and provide an ingredient of shengmaisan (DRUGS, CHINESE HERBAL).

D031442.name: Ornithogalum
D031442.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains cholestane glycosides (CHOLESTANES).

D031443.name: Ruscus
D031443.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. This should not be confused with Broom or Scotch Broom (CYTISUS) or Desert Broom (BACCHARIS) or Spanish Broom (SPARTIUM) or Brome (BROMUS).

D031444.name: Sansevieria
D031444.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains steroidal saponins.

D031445.name: Scilla
D031445.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain the cardiotonic PROSCILLARIDIN. The common name of squill is also used for URGINEA.

D031446.name: Trillium
D031446.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that is a short plant with a distinct whorl of 3 broad leaves.

D031447.name: Tulipa
D031447.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE. Members contain tuliposides and tulipalins and have been associated with allergic contact dermatitis in florists.

D031448.name: Urginea
D031448.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that contains bufadienolides (BUFANOLIDES). The common name of squill is also used for SCILLA.

D031449.name: Zigadenus
D031449.definition: A plant genus of the family LILIACEAE that is fatally toxic to grazing animals. The name is similar to another plant called Camas (CAMASSIA).

D031450.name: Gelsemium
D031450.definition: A plant genus of the family LOGANIACEAE (classified by some botanists as Gelsemiaceae). The sometimes used common name of trumpet flower is also used for DATURA.

D031451.name: Strychnos
D031451.definition: A plant genus of the family LOGANIACEAE (classified by some botanists as Strychnaceae).

D031461.name: Strychnos nux-vomica
D031461.definition: A plant genus of the genus STRYCHNOS, family LOGANIACEAE that is the source of STRYCHNINE.

D031482.name: Cynomorium
D031482.definition: A plant genus of the family BALANOPHORACEAE. Members contain stigmastanes and ursanes (TRITERPENES) and lignan glucopyranosides (LIGNANS).

D031483.name: Capparaceae
D031483.definition: A plant family of the order Capparales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida, that are mostly herbs and shrubs growing in warm arid regions. Several produce GLUCOSINOLATES.

D031484.name: Capparis
D031484.definition: A plant genus of the family CAPPARACEAE that contains mabinlin, a sweet protein.

D031485.name: Cleome
D031485.definition: A plant genus of the family CAPPARACEAE that contains cleogynol and 15alpha-acetoxycleomblynol (dammaranes) and 1-epibrachyacarpone (a triterpene), and ISOTHIOCYANATES.

D031501.name: Gleditsia
D031501.definition: A plant genus of the family FABACEAE that contains gleditsiosides (triterpenoid SAPONINS).

D031521.name: Fractionation, Field Flow
D031521.definition: Separation of molecules and particles by a simultaneous action of carrier liquid flow and focusing field forces (electrical, sedimentation, or thermal), without a stationary phase.

D031541.name: Fluorescence Resonance Energy Transfer
D031541.definition: A type of FLUORESCENCE SPECTROSCOPY using two FLUORESCENT DYES with overlapping emission and absorption spectra, which is used to indicate proximity of labeled molecules. This technique is useful for studying interactions of molecules and PROTEIN FOLDING.

D031561.name: Lythrum
D031561.definition: A plant genus of the family LYTHRACEAE that contains ALKALOIDS.

D031562.name: Cuphea
D031562.definition: A plant genus of the family LYTHRACEAE. Members contain lauric acid and cuphiin.

D031563.name: Lagerstroemia
D031563.definition: A plant genus of the family LYTHRACEAE. Members contain lagertannin and have hypoglycemic effects.

D031564.name: Lawsonia Plant
D031564.definition: A plant genus of the family LYTHRACEAE that is the source of henna and has cytotoxic activity.

D031565.name: Woodfordia
D031565.definition: A plant genus of the family LYTHRACEAE. Members contain woodfordins.

D031566.name: Magnolia
D031566.definition: A plant genus of the family MAGNOLIACEAE. The germacranolide sesquiterpene lactones costunolide, parthenolide, and costunolide diepoxide have been isolated from the leaves. Bark contains honokiol and magnolol. Parts are an ingredient of Banxia Houpo Tang.

D031567.name: Liriodendron
D031567.definition: A plant genus of the family MAGNOLIACEAE. Members include hardwood trees of eastern North America with distinct large tuliplike flowers.

D031581.name: Banisteriopsis
D031581.definition: A plant genus of the family MALPIGHIACEAE which includes an Amazonian psychoactive plant that contains the beta-carboline harmine and N,N-dimethyltryptamine.

D031582.name: Galphimia
D031582.definition: A plant genus of the family MALPIGHIACEAE. G. glauca is the source of 'Galphimia glauca extract' and contains 'galphimine B' and tetragalloylquinic acid.

D031583.name: Althaea
D031583.definition: A plant genus of the family MALVACEAE known for mucilaginous roots. The common names of hollyhock and mallow are also used for other genera of MALVACEAE.

D031584.name: Hibiscus
D031584.definition: A plant genus of the family MALVACEAE. Members contain CITRIC ACID; MALATES; ANTHOCYANINS; FLAVONOIDS; GLYCOSIDES; DIETARY FIBER; and LIGNANS. Hibiscus sabdariffa is common constituent of HERBAL TEAS. Hibiscus cannabinus is a source of hemp fiber for TEXTILES.

D031585.name: Melia
D031585.definition: A plant genus of the family MELIACEAE. Members contain meliavolkinin, melianin C and limonoids.

D031586.name: Melia azedarach
D031586.definition: A plant species of the genus MELIA, family MELIACEAE, which is toxic to insects. The name is very similar to Melia azadirachta (AZADIRACHTA).

D031587.name: Cedrela
D031587.definition: A plant genus of the family MELIACEAE. Members contain cedrelanolide.

D031601.name: Azadirachta
D031601.definition: A plant genus of the family MELIACEAE. Members contain azadirachtin A (a limonoid commonly referred to as azadirachtin) and other TRITERPENES. They have been used in PESTICIDES. The old name of Melia azadirachta is very similar to a related plant, MELIA AZEDARACH.

D031602.name: Aglaia
D031602.definition: A plant genus of the family MELIACEAE. Members contain lariciresinol, pregnanes, insecticidal rocaglamide derivatives and other compounds.

D031603.name: Menispermum
D031603.definition: A plant genus of the family MENISPERMACEAE. Members contain dauricine and other ALKALOIDS.

D031604.name: Cyclea
D031604.definition: A plant genus of the family MENISPERMACEAE. Members contain bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloids.

D031605.name: Cocculus
D031605.definition: A plant genus of the family MENISPERMACEAE. Members contain sinococuline, coccuvine and other ALKALOIDS.

D031606.name: Cissampelos
D031606.definition: A plant genus of the family MENISPERMACEAE. Members contain eletefine (a stephaoxocane alkaloid) and tropoloisoquinoline and protoberberine ALKALOIDS.

D031607.name: Stephania
D031607.definition: A plant genus of the family MENISPERMACEAE. Members contain cycleanine.

D031608.name: Area Postrema
D031608.definition: A small, rounded eminence on each side of the FOURTH VENTRICLE, which receives nerve fibers from the SOLITARY NUCLEUS; SPINAL CORD; and adjacent areas of the MEDULLA OBLONGATA. The area postrema lies outside the BLOOD-BRAIN BARRIER and its functions include acting as an emetic chemoreceptor.

D031609.name: Stephania tetrandra
D031609.definition: A plant species of the genus STEPHANIA, family MENISPERMACEAE, that contains tetrandrine and bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloids.

D031610.name: Tinospora
D031610.definition: A plant genus of the family MENISPERMACEAE. Members have been used in AYURVEDIC MEDICINE. Hypoglycemic effect has been reported.

D031611.name: Peumus
D031611.definition: A plant genus of the family MONIMIACEAE. Members contain boldine ALKALOIDS. Some PEUMUS species have been reclassified as CRYPTOCARYA.

D031621.name: Antiaris
D031621.definition: A plant genus of the family MORACEAE. Members have been used as an arrow poison.

D031622.name: Artocarpus
D031622.definition: A plant genus of the family MORACEAE. Puag-haad extract, from A. lakoocha, contains STILBENES and related 4-substituted RESORCINOLS.

D031623.name: Broussonetia
D031623.definition: A plant genus of the family MORACEAE. Members contain PYRROLIDINES.

D031624.name: Maclura
D031624.definition: A plant genus of the family MORACEAE. Members contain maclurin, antifungal chalcones, and other compounds.

D031625.name: Morus
D031625.definition: A plant genus of the family MORACEAE that is widely planted for shade.

D031641.name: Myrica
D031641.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRICACEAE. Members contain myricanol. The common name of bayberry is similar to the name barberry which is used for BERBERIS and MAHONIA.

D031642.name: Myoporaceae
D031642.definition: A plant family of the order Scrophulariales, subclass Asteridae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031643.name: Myoporum
D031643.definition: A plant genus of the family MYOPORACEAE. Members contain dehydrongaione, deisopropylngaione, dehydromyodesmone and other furanoid sesquiterpene essential oils. It is the source of Ngaio oil and ngaione.

D031644.name: Ardisia
D031644.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRSINACEAE. Members contain ardisiacrispins (oleanane triterpenoid saponins), ardicrenin, and cyclamiretin.

D031645.name: Embelia
D031645.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRSINACEAE. Members contain embelin.

D031646.name: Feijoa
D031646.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRTACEAE that is cultivated for the edible fruit, which is different from the ordinary guava (PSIDIUM).

D031647.name: Psidium
D031647.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRTACEAE that bears an edible fruit and contains guavin B and quercetin glycosides.

D031648.name: Kunzea
D031648.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRTACEAE. The common name of tea tree more often refers to MELALEUCA or LEPTOSPERMUM.

D031649.name: Leptospermum
D031649.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRTACEAE. The common name of tea tree is also used for MELALEUCA and KUNZEA.

D031650.name: Melaleuca
D031650.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRTACEAE. M. alternifolia foliage is a source of TEA TREE OIL. The common name of tea tree also refers to LEPTOSPERMUM or KUNZEA. M. vindifolia is a source of niaouli oil. M. cajuputi and M. leucadendra are sources of cajuput oil.

D031651.name: Myrtus
D031651.definition: A plant genus of the family MYRTACEAE. Members contain PHYTOHEMAGGLUTININS.

D031652.name: Nelumbonaceae
D031652.definition: A plant family of the order Nymphaeales, subclass Magnoliidae, class Magnoliopsida. They are aquatic plants.

D031653.name: Nelumbo
D031653.definition: A plant genus of the family NELUMBONACEAE. The common name of lotus is also for LOTUS and NYMPHAEA.

D031654.name: Nuphar
D031654.definition: A plant genus of the family NYMPHAEACEAE. Members contain sesquiterpene thioalkaloids.

D031655.name: Nyssa
D031655.definition: A plant genus of the family NYSSACEAE (or Cornaceae by some).

D031656.name: Olacaceae
D031656.definition: A small plant family of the order Santalales, subclass Rosidae, class Magnoliopsida.

D031657.name: Forsythia
D031657.definition: A plant genus of the family OLEACEAE. Members contain suspensaside.

D031658.name: Olea
D031658.definition: A plant genus of the family Oleaceae. The olive fruit is the source of olive oil.

D031659.name: Ligustrum
D031659.definition: A plant genus of the family OLEACEAE. Oleuropein, a phenolic secoiridoid glycoside, is found in the leaves.

D031660.name: Jasminum
D031660.definition: A plant genus of the family OLEACEAE. Members contain secoiridoid glucosides and this is the source of oil of jasmine.

D031661.name: Fraxinus
D031661.definition: A plant genus of the family OLEACEAE. Members contain secoiridoid glucosides.

D031662.name: Syringa
D031662.definition: A plant genus of the family OLEACEAE. Oleuropein has been identified in the stem bark.

D031663.name: Clarkia
D031663.definition: A plant genus, of the family ONAGRACEAE, which is the subject of genetic studies. The floral aroma is attributed to benzenoid esters and benzyl acetate.

D031664.name: Oenothera
D031664.definition: A plant genus of the family ONAGRACEAE. Members contain oenotheins.

D031665.name: Oenothera biennis
D031665.definition: A plant species, of the genus OENOTHERA, family ONAGRACEAE, that is the source of evening primrose oil.

D031666.name: Epilobium
D031666.definition: A plant genus of the family ONAGRACEAE. The common name of fireweed is also used with other plants.

D031667.name: Dendrobium
D031667.definition: A plant genus of the family ORCHIDACEAE that contains dihydroayapin (COUMARINS) and phenanthraquinones.

D031668.name: Gastrodia
D031668.definition: A plant genus of the family ORCHIDACEAE which depends on the fungus Armillaria mellea to complete its life cycle. It is an ingredient of Zhenxuanyin (DRUGS, CHINESE HERBAL).

D031669.name: Vanilla
D031669.definition: A plant genus of the family ORCHIDACEAE that is the source of the familiar flavoring used in foods and medicines (FLAVORING AGENTS).

D031670.name: Orobanchaceae
D031670.definition: The broom-rape plant family of the order Lamiales.

D031671.name: Cistanche
D031671.definition: A plant genus of the family OROBANCHACEAE. Members contain phenylethanoid glycosides.

D031672.name: Orobanche
D031672.definition: A plant genus of the family OROBANCHACEAE. Lacking chlorophyll, they are nonphotosynthetic parasitic plants. The common name is similar to Broom or Scotch Broom (CYTISUS) or Butcher's Broom (RUSCUS) or Desert Broom (BACCHARIS) or Spanish Broom (SPARTIUM) or Brome (BROMUS).

D031673.name: Pandanaceae
D031673.definition: A plant family of the order Pandanales, subclass Arecidae, class Liliopsida (monocotyledons).

D031674.name: Argemone
D031674.definition: A plant genus of the family PAPAVERACEAE that contains isoquinoline alkaloids.

D031675.name: Eschscholzia
D031675.definition: A plant genus of the family PAPAVERACEAE that contains benzo[c]phenanthridine alkaloids.

D031681.name: Sanguinaria
D031681.definition: A plant genus of the family PAPAVERACEAE. S. canadensis is the source of sanguinarine extract used in MOUTHWASHES.

D031683.name: Passifloraceae
D031683.definition: A plant family of the order Violales, subclass Dilleniidae, class Magnoliopsida that are herbaceous or woody vines, shrubs, and trees, mostly of warm regions. Many have tendrils in leaf axils. Leaves are alternate. Flowers have 3-5 sepals, petals and stamens. Nearly all species have seeds that bear a fleshy appendage called an aril.

D031684.name: Harpagophytum
D031684.definition: A plant genus of the family PEDALIACEAE. Members contain harpagoside.

D031685.name: Sesamum
D031685.definition: A plant genus of the family PEDALIACEAE that is the source of the edible seed and SESAME OIL.

D031686.name: Tagetes
D031686.definition: A plant genus of the family ASTERACEAE. The common name of marigold is also used for CALENDULA.

D031701.name: Piper
D031701.definition: A plant genus of the family PIPERACEAE that includes species used for spicy and stimulating qualities.

D031702.name: Agropyron
D031702.definition: A plant genus of the family POACEAE. The common name of wheatgrass is also used for other plants in the family.

D031703.name: Agrostis
D031703.definition: A plant genus of the family POACEAE.

D031721.name: Piper betle
D031721.definition: A plant genus of the family PIPERACEAE that is indigenous in the Indian Malay region and cultivated in Madagascar, and the West Indies. It contains chavibetol, chavicol and cadinene. The leaf is chewed as a stimulant, antiseptic and sialogogue. The common name of betel is also used for ARECA.

D031722.name: Andropogon
D031722.definition: A plant genus of the family POACEAE. The common name of bluestem is also used for other plants in this family. Andropogon nardus has been reclassified as CYMBOPOGON nardus and Andropogon zizanioides to VETIVERIA zizanioides.

D031723.name: Bambusa
D031723.definition: A plant genus of the family POACEAE. Young shoots are eaten in Asian foods while the stiff mature stems are used for construction of many things. The common name of bamboo is also used for other genera of Poaceae including Phyllostachys, SASA, and Dendrocalamus.

D031724.name: Bromus
D031724.definition: A plant genus of the family POACEAE. The name is similar to Broom or Scotch Broom (CYTISUS) or Butcher's Broom (RUSCUS) or Desert Broom (BACCHARIS) or Spanish Broom (SPARTIUM).

D031741.name: Cenchrus
D031741.definition: A plant genus of the family POACEAE. The common name of buffelgrass is also used for PENNISETUM.

D031742.name: Coix
